answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 6 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 69 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. The saffron keeps the gate honest, the zephyr keeps the farm poor, and the whisper keeps the honest agent paid.
